reviews.text: After our regular groomer stopped, it took a bit of searching, but with Lynn we are in good hands. Skillfully clipping and grooming a Coton du Tulear is truly a craft in itself, and Lynn does it fantastically. The result is exactly as promised on her website. Sjonnie looks beautiful again, and we are very satisfied!
An incredibly nice grooming salon! Bink was groomed this week and looks great again. Lynn is very nice with Bink and he comes out happy and fresh every time!
Relaxed and good grooming salon. Clear communication, nice atmosphere, and good groomers!!

Highly recommended! Lynn knows what she's doing, she gives the right attention, and my dog ​​always looks fantastic. My dog ​​had a minor trauma at his previous grooming salon, which made him a bit anxious. That completely subsided after a few visits to Furmidabel.

We're always very happy with Lynn from Furmidabel dog grooming salon. Our dog, Snowy, a Maremma Golden Retriever mix, always has a lot of hair. But after a wash and a trim, she looks neat and smells wonderful again.

Our Billy is a Miniature Poodle with a feisty character, but Lynn, with all her patience, doesn't shy away from that! Billy is now 8 months old and comes to Lynn with great pleasure, leaving with a fantastic haircut 👍🏻.
Billy's owners are also happy with Lynn. …
Our Maltipoo, Lumi, has been coming here since she was a puppy and always comes back happy and beautifully groomed! Very friendly and attentive service!
A fantastic dog grooming salon for our Australian Labradoodle, Millie. Lynn is a skilled and sweet groomer; we're always very satisfied. Highly recommended!

Our Cocker Spaniel was groomed with incredible skill by Lyn. The parts that are so tricky on a Spaniel (ears/paws) were carefully and neatly trimmed. Due to a holiday, the hair on the legs was very long. All the sand and dirt that we couldn't get rid of was carefully removed, meaning our dog won't have any tangles for a long time to come. Very nice! We will definitely be back.
Absolutely brilliant! Got a clean and fluffy dog back and they clearly know what they’re doing. Also very good price so will for sure come back many times! 😊 …
A very nice salon, where the passion for the dog clients is clearly palpable.
I am happy with how Bob came away. Well and beautifully groomed, and he looks happy. 👍 …
We were very happy with our dog's haircut and we also got a great before and after video!

Lynn started to take care of my dog Luke since he was as a puppy. He loves going to the treatment so much! She doesn’t only do her job professionally but also takes good care of the dog with love and joy. Highly recommended.
A really great grooming salon for my Bernese. My dog ​​is always happy, fresh, and beautifully groomed when I come to pick him up.
Our Labradoodle is groomed by Lynn every 3 months. We are always very satisfied, and Jutta looks great afterwards.

Furmidabel is a wonderful grooming salon to leave our Kyra at! They're super friendly, do great work, and the icing on the cake is that they always take lovely photos of the process! Definitely recommended.

After a bad experience at another groomer, we ended up at Furmidabel with our Toy Poodle, Scottie.

Lynn takes the time to listen to your wishes. She cuts beautifully. We always want Scottie in a teddy bear style, and we finally found someone who can do that too. Scottie is also sometimes a bit nervous, but this is also completely fine at Furmidabel. The salon is cozy, clean, and spacious. And easy to get to. Highly recommended!

I bring my dog ​​Fay (Spanish Water Dog) here four times a year for a grooming session. Every time, I am fully satisfied. Lynn (the owner) always puts Fay at ease before she starts. She gives Fay her full attention. Lynn helps find solutions and possibilities regarding the grooming.
Fay comes back happy and freshly groomed every time.
